defective_pattern: Consolidating regression analysis into a single unified table that lumps together R², F, beta, and t-values without separate ANOVA decomposition and correlation matrices.
why_defective: Violates the institutional 3-Table Standard required by graduate thesis guidelines and prevents full diagnostic transparency of regression sums of squares, residual degrees of freedom, Durbin-Watson autocorrelation, and tolerance/VIF multicollinearity.
observed_symptoms: A single table containing R, R2, F, and Beta values.
Missing Correlation matrix table preceding regression results.
corrective_remedy: Decompose each regression reporting block into the mandatory 3 tables: Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (ANOVA & Model Summary), Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Absence of ANOVA sum of squares or Correlation matrix in regression reporting blocks, or detection of a single table row containing both model summary (R2/F) and coefficient estimates (Beta/t).
